caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object resembling an ornate vessel or oil can, rendered in shades of black, gray, and white on a beige background. The vessel has a broad, rounded base with a decorative band featuring a scrolling motif around its widest part. A curved handle is attached to one side, and the top of the vessel is slightly narrower, with two elongated objects extending vertically from the opening, possibly utensils or tools. A chain connects part of the upper opening to the top edge. The drawing is centered horizontally and placed in the upper middle portion of a larger, rectangular outlined area. In the lower right corner of the outlined area, there is a smaller, simplified line drawing of the same vessel, showing its profile and key features in less detail. The artist’s name, “Louis Annino,” is printed just below this secondary drawing.
title: Lamp
